section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1999
title: 2.10.4 The sex-wise break-up and details of percentage distribution of the means adopted for suicide in the various States/Uts & Cities are given in Table-26. Expectedly, for all the means of suicides, male victims were more except for suicides by 'Self immolation' where share of female victims was more (67.9%). 2.10.5 More than 22 percent suicides in Delhi were committed by 'Fire/ Self Immolation'. More than 80 percent in Andhra Pradesh and A&N Islands were due to Hanging, and more than 30 percent in Tripura & Andhra Pradesh were committed by consuming Insecticides. 2.10.6 The Table-2.12 gives age and sex-wise distribution of suicide victims based on various means adopted for suicide. The share of male suicide victims was more for all kinds of means adopted except 'Fire/Self Immolation'. Comparatively lesser boys (527) than girls (706) committed suicide 'By Consuming Poison' and less number of youngmen (1599) than young women (1715) committed suicide by 'Drowning'.
